features:
Features

Rich, chocolatey flavor
Delivers classic, indulgent brownies thanks to its cocoa and chocolate-flavored syrup blend.

Simple, few-ingredient recipe
Just mix in water, vegetable oil, and an egg (or two for a cakelike texture), and bake—no complicated steps.

Ready in minutes
Prep is quick (under 5 minutes), with bake time varying by pan size (e.g., 28–38 minutes).

Includes a pouch of chocolate syrup
Adds depth of flavor and helps create moist, fudgy brownies.

Crackly, shiny top
Offers that visually appealing, classic brownie finish.

Box Tops For Education
Participating product—supports schools through the Box Tops program.

Low fat / low cholesterol / low sodium
Contains 0 g trans fat and only 6 g fat plus ~95 mg sodium per serving when prepared.

Kosher-certified & SNAP-EBT eligible
Approved by dietary and assistance programs.

No hydrogenated oils, artificial colors, or sweeteners
Cleaner ingredient profile compared to some other mixes. 

Benefits

No-fuss baking
Ideal for busy days or beginner bakers—no need for fancy ingredients or equipment, just follow easy instructions.

Moist and satisfying texture
The built-in syrup pouch keeps brownies gooey and luscious, avoiding dryness

Perfect for any occasion
Whether it's a weeknight dessert, bake sale, potluck, or after-school treat, this mix delivers consistently crowd-pleasing results.

Customizable recipe
Enhance with nuts, chocolate chips, or swirl-ins to suit preferences or dietary needs.

Visual & taste appeal
Shiny, crinkle-topped brownies look homemade and upscale, adding to enjoyment

Family-friendly & economical
Great for daily dessert consumption or bulk baking, with good portioning and school program benefits.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Flavored Syrup (high fructose corn syrup, corn syrup, water, cocoa processed with alkali, corn starch, palm oil, ethoxylated mono and diglycerides, citric acid, salt, potassium sorbate [preservative], artificial flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Salt, Carob Powder.
